meta.name: offer_documents
meta.description: The printed text of a rated offer's Word document (jav/app/rated_offer.py; the output rated_offer of configs/outputs.json): its value labels and its two tables' headers (the modules' premiums, the factors on the total; for a person's own template's marker list too), the built-in template's texts (document vocabulary, Hungarian: the document a client reads) and its page layout. A change of the text is a version; it changes no figure.

changelog.note: The first version: the insurance quote's Word document in Hungarian.
The notes and the description without the development process's references; no value changes.
